body.message:
Good morning Talal,

Unfortunately, we are unable to extend your stay in the current apartment, as the unit has been offboarded from our side and handed back to the landlord after your check out date.

However, if you would like to move to another unit, we have one studio apartment available after your current check-out date. Please note that this unit is located on the 6th floor and does not have a view.

Please let us know if you would be interested, and we will be happy to share the details with you.

Thank you for your understanding.
